notes: διάκονος is used for servant, minister, or deacon. Phoebe is linked to a named congregation; the main text uses ‘deacon’ without importing a later fixed office structure.
προστάτις describes a benefactor, patron, or protector. Phoebe is presented as a person who materially and socially supported many, including Paul.
Junia is the normal feminine form. ‘Outstanding among the apostles’ naturally places Andronicus and Junia within the notable apostolic group; ‘well known to the apostles’ is also argued.
Paul's phrase can call Rufus's mother ‘his mother and mine,’ using family language for her care of Paul.

The pinned SBLGNT main text contains this grace benediction. TSW omits public verse 24 and instead prints the movable doxology as verses 25–27, which is absent from the pinned main text; those non-equivalent texts are not aligned as comparators.
